original_u.source_units: common bulk coupling t, never S/N
original_u.nested_thermal_convention: hold both nested saturation constraints fixed and differentiate the remaining Bernoulli probability; not an unconstrained one-level thermal derivative
original_u.root_scope: local regular continuation exists around homogeneous zero coupling; global root uniqueness at arbitrary couplings is not asserted
